title: Iconotype icon font
description: A committed icon font project: the artwork, its codepoints, and where a build writes its output.

name.description: Identifies the font: the family name, the class prefix root, and what autocompletion triggers on.

height.description: Coordinate space the paths are drawn in. Independent of the output em size.

family.description: font-family name in the generated CSS

prefix.description: Class prefix, e.g. "app-". Autocompletion triggers on it. May interpolate ${i} (glyph index) and ${u} (codepoint in hex).

usagePrefixes.description: Prefixes your CODE writes, when a build step rewrites them — e.g. a webpack alias that maps "alpimaps-hiking" onto the "icon-hiking" class. Completion, usage, rename and diagnostics look for these as well as for the class prefix; the first is what tooling inserts.

postfix.description: Class suffix. May interpolate ${i} and ${u}, e.g. "-${u}" gives .icon-home-e900.

emSize.description: Units per em in the built font.

baseline.description: Descender, as a percentage of the em.

whitespace.description: Space glyph advance, as a percentage of the em.

propertyPerGlyph.description: Emit --icon-home: "\e900" on :root, for referencing a codepoint from your own rules.

glyphNames.description: Write human-readable names into the font's post table. Off makes the font slightly smaller.

palettePrefix.description: Class prefix for multicolor palettes: "palette" gives .palette1, .palette2.

allColorPalettes.description: Emit a rule set for every colour palette, not just the active one.

metadata.description: Written into the font's name table, where a font inspector or a licence audit will read it.

output.description: Where a build writes its files. Committed so the editor, the CLI and CI agree.

dir.description: Directory the font files are written to, relative to the project root (see the spec). A list writes the same files to each, e.g. ["web/fonts", "mobile/assets/fonts"]. Each file is named <font.family>.<format>.

formats.description: Font formats to write into each dir, e.g. ["woff2", "woff", "ttf"].

publicPath.description: What the @font-face src should point at. Computed relative to each stylesheet when omitted.

enumDescriptions: $app-home: "\e900"; with the family and font path up front

path.description: File to write, relative to the project root, e.g. "app/css/_icons.scss". A list writes the same content to each; the @font-face url is computed for the first one.

styles.description: Stylesheets and code files to generate. Several entries may share a kind.

path.description: A .d.ts union of every icon name.
An SVG <symbol> sprite of every selected icon.
A standalone HTML page previewing every icon.

name.description: Unique. Used for the class name (prefix + name + postfix) and autocompletion. Keep to [a-z0-9_-].

code.description: Codepoint in hex, without U+. Never change one: it is the font's API.

codes.description: Extra codepoints for a multicolor icon's additional layers.

selected.description: false keeps the artwork but leaves it out of the built font.

ligatures.description: Text that renders as this icon when typed in the font, e.g. "home".

grid.description: Source grid the artwork was drawn on. 0 means none.

width.description: Advance width in coordinate units. Omit for square.

paths.description: SVG path data in the 0..height (y-down) coordinate space, already normalized: filled closed contours, nonzero winding, no strokes. A monochrome icon may have several entries (subpaths of one shape); with colors, each entry is one colour layer.

colors.description: Per-layer CSS colour, parallel to paths. Two or more entries make the icon multicolor: each layer then needs its own codepoint (code + codes).

icons.description: Every icon. Names must be unique. Writers sort by codepoint.

credits.description: Licence and attribution for the artwork's origin.
